title: Chapter 2.3 — Solving Inequalities Using Multiplication or Division

cards.front: What happens to the inequality symbol when you multiply or divide both sides by a [[imp:positive number]]?
cards.back: The inequality symbol [[imp:stays the same]]. Example: $ -6 < 8 $, multiply by 2: $ -12 < 16 $.
Multiply both sides by 8: $ x > -40 $. Graph: open circle at -40, shade right.
Divide both sides by 3: $ -8 \ge x $, which is $ x \le -8 $. Graph: closed circle at -8, shade left.
[[imp:Reverse the inequality symbol]]. Example: $ 6 > -8 $, divide by -2: $ -3 < 4 $.
cards.front: What is the rule when multiplying or dividing both sides of an inequality by a [[imp:negative number]]?

cards.back: Divide by -7 and reverse $ \le $ to $ \ge $: $ y \ge 5 $. Graph: closed circle at 5, shade right.
Multiply by -3 and reverse < to >: $ -6 > y $, so $ y < -6 $. Graph: open circle at -6, shade left.
Divide by -9 and reverse > to <: $ m < -7 $. Graph: open circle at -7, shade left.

cards.front: What is the first thing to check before multiplying or dividing to solve an inequality?
cards.back: Check whether the number you are multiplying or dividing by is [[imp:positive or negative]]. If negative, you must reverse the symbol.
Divide by 4 (positive, keep symbol): $ x < 2 $. Graph: open circle at 2, shade left.
Divide by -6 (negative, reverse < to >): $ t > -2 $. Graph: open circle at -2, shade right.
Multiply by -5 and reverse $ \le $ to $ \ge $: $ w \ge -80 $. Graph: closed circle at -80, shade right.
$ 9.5n \ge 247 $. Divide by 9.5: $ n \ge 26 $. You must work [[imp:at least 26 hours]].
cards.front: You earn $9.50 per hour and need $247 for a camera. Write and solve an inequality for hours $n$.
You have $3.65 for copies that cost $0.25 each. Write an inequality for the number of copies $c$.
cards.back: $ 0.25c \le 3.65 $. Divide by 0.25: $ c \le 14.6 $, so at most [[imp:14 copies]] (whole number).
$ -8h \le -36 $ (since the change is negative). Divide by -8 and reverse: $ h \ge 4.5 $ hours.
cards.front: A temperature drops 8°F per hour. How many hours $h$ to drop at least 36°F? Set up the inequality.
What is the blueprint for solving multiplication/division inequalities?
cards.back: [[imp:Understand]] (coefficient sign, symbol) → [[imp:Solve]] (multiply/divide; reverse symbol if negative) → [[imp:Conclude]] (graph, check).
